execute_async_with_retry: use RetryHandler to execute an async function with automatic retries on exceptions
execute_sync_with_retry: use RetryHandler to execute a blocking function with automatic retries on exceptions
configure_backoff_strategy: configure RetryHandler with constant, linear, or exponential backoff between retry attempts
handle_multiple_exception_types: pass a tuple of exception types to RetryHandler to retry on multiple exception kinds
test_retry_handler_with_logging: test RetryHandler behavior by verifying logger warning and error calls on retries
